features.feature_instruction: The Shared Backend Utilities feature provides foundational components for consistent error handling and custom exceptions across the Prakash Stores backend application. It includes `GlobalExceptionHandler.java`, which centralizes the handling of various exceptions, mapping them to appropriate HTTP status codes and standard `ErrorResponse` DTOs. Specifically, it handles `ResourceNotFoundException` by returning an HTTP 404 Not Found status with a descriptive error message. The `ErrorResponse.java` DTO defines a standardized structure for error messages returned by the API, ensuring consistency. `ResourceNotFoundException.java` is a custom exception class used by services and controllers when a requested entity or resource cannot be found in the system. Other features will throw `ResourceNotFoundException` when an entity is not found, and `GlobalExceptionHandler` will catch it and return a 404 response.
